question: Should CodexBar accept sending the complete browser-matched longcat.chat cookie set to LongCat's same-origin console endpoints for this disabled-by-default provider?
rationale: The code can constrain transport and source selection, but only the repository owner can decide whether the undocumented minimum credential makes complete-cookie forwarding an acceptable permanent privacy boundary.

options.title: Accept guarded full-cookie auth
options.body: Approve the current same-origin, isolated-session design with Auto limited to user-initiated app refreshes and Chrome-only default import.

options.title: Require a narrower credential
options.body: Keep the provider unmerged until a documented cookie name, scoped token, or supported usage endpoint is available.

options.title: Allow manual cookies only
options.body: Remove automatic browser import and accept only an explicitly pasted Cookie header, reducing implicit credential access at the cost of setup friction.

recommendation.title: Accept guarded full-cookie auth
recommendation.body: Approve the current same-origin, isolated-session design with Auto limited to user-initiated app refreshes and Chrome-only default import.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the repository, authored the current head, and merged the closest analogous hardened cookie-provider implementation.
